notes.title: Name Change Incoming: What’s Going to Change
notes.content:
As you know, we always listen to feedback from our community, and many of you have mentioned that the game’s name can be hard to remember.

That’s why, starting September 16th, we will be making a significant change to the brand: the game will now be called [b]USAC: Code Breach[/b]. 'USAC' refers to the Special Unit Against Cyber Attacks, while 'Code Breach' is a nod to the gameplay and storyline. But we won't reveal more for now! The sequel to this episode is already part of our future project portfolio, so get ready for more adventures with the USAC!

[u][b]What Will Change for You[/b][/u]

[list] 
[*] You'll be able to remember the game's name and talk about it with others, thanks to its syllables of exceptional lightness, no more memory lapses or long, complicated words! 
[*] Starting September 16th, make sure to update the game; otherwise, you won't be able to launch it from the "play" button on Steam. 
[*] If you were in the middle of an adventure when the game was still named Bonding Ambivalence, you'll just need to copy the save files from one folder to another, as explained below (well, it’s not called a hacking game for nothing!). 
[/list]

Starting September 16th, if you had a game in progress: [olist]
[*] Go to the directory: [i]C:\Users[YourAccount]\AppData\Local\BondingAmbivalence\Saved\SaveGames[/i] and make a backup copy of all the files in the folder;
[*] Update the game and launch the application, then close it; 
[*] Go to the directory [i]C:\Users[YourAccount]\AppData\Local\USACCodeBreach\Saved\SaveGames[/i] and paste the files you previously copied; 
[*] You can continue your adventure. 
[/olist]

If you run into any trouble with your saves, we'll always be there to help out on Discord! ;)

notes.title: New Speedrun.com page
notes.content:
Attention to all speedrun enthusiasts, we've created a page on speedrun.com at the request of [b]Herzet[/b] ([b]FR[/b]) and [b]Romalow[/b] ([b]FR[/b])! It's now possible for you to submit your runs on the [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Bonding_Ambivalence]page[/url] and try to win the best time.

[h1]Want to submit a time? How to do it?[/h1]

Currently, you can apply to submit time for three distinct categories:
[list]
[*] NG+ Any%: you need to finish the game once to unlock the game's timer, which will be used to count your time,
[*] NG+ USAC mode: the same as the previous category, but in USAC mode, i.e. with a permadeath option,
[*] Any%: the same as the first category, but with third-party software as your timer,
[*] You can also attempt to beat the time records for the Digital Operator and Infiltration Agent training sessions in solo mode.
[/list]
Want to beat our record of 1 hour 13 minutes and 40 seconds? Start the game, train (for a long time) and submit your time! To do so, go to the speedrun [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Bonding_Ambivalence]game page here[/url].

[i]You will be asked to provide a video proof of your time, including a capture of the actual duration of the operation. In the game, you can find this duration in the statistics file by clicking on "Play" then "Stats" in the "Saved" category. Once on the file, simply scroll down the menu until you see "Game duration". Only this time will be used to validate your game, so make sure you've taken a video of it before sending your proof![/i]

[h1]Want to know more about speedrun rules?[/h1]

All the rules will be posted soon on the speedrun.com page. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact us on our [url=https://discord.gg/TbGfNcetKq]Discord server[/url]!

We hope you enjoy your training and may RNG be with you!

Idreak and Dazarious for Questions Factory

notes.title: Patch notes - March 14
notes.content:
[h3]We decided to make one change about the Infiltration Agent[/h3]

Many of you have identified a certain imbalance in terms of participation between the two classes. The Digital Operator often had to read a lot of information while the Infiltration Agent was waiting. It was decided that [b]the Infiltration Agent could access the database to brainstorm puzzles with his partner[/b]. This eliminates "holes" in the gameplay and improves cooperation. However, the database is shared with the Infiltration Agent over a certain distance (like a wifi signal), the strength of the signal decreases with the distance from the Digital Operator and also with the presence of walls between the source and its receiver. This still allows for some asymmetry during key moments (when the two are far apart) but also allows them to think together when they are together.

[u][b]Other changes[/b][/u]
We look for where things can get potentially frustrating and reinforce the weak points.
[list]
[*] [spoiler] Princeps: the electric motor is now scannable (it was too difficult to spot otherwise) [/spoiler];
[*] When a hacking task encountered an error, it was sometimes hard to know that you had to enter a command to restart (it was drowned in the terminal). Now this command is explicitly shown directly on the task module.
[/list]

We continue to scan google and your reviews and see what we can improve. Thanks for your feedback ;)

Dazarious for Questions Factory

notes.title: Update notes - november 16 2022
notes.content:
[h3]As always, we thank all those who support us in this adventure![/h3]

Every day we take a close look at the feedback you give us in order to improve the game experience. So we have detected a few things that needed to be fixed.

[b]Training section[/b]
According to your feedback, the training section needed to be improved as it represented an unjustified difficulty. There were also missing explanations in the mini lessons of the tutorial.
[list]
[*] We have improved the training courses by including more explanations about the Infiltration Agent and the gameplay in general;
[*] We changed the way the Infiltration Agent had to distract the guards;
[*] For both classes, we removed the mobile guard which was too difficult to manage.
[/list]
[b]Small fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Default input binding for [b]Move Left[/b] is reset to [b]A[/b];
[*] Default input binding for [b]Trample[/b] is reset to [b]Z[/b];
[*] We corrected some geometry clipping issues;
[*] Puzzle: [spoiler]Train Station - no longer possible to activate the lever without removing the plate[/spoiler].
[/list]
[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] We added some hints for the Princeps area;
[*] We added one energy station in [spoiler]the registration area (to avoid penalizing those who have no energy from the start)[/spoiler];
[*] Now possible to quit the external interface of the backpack by pressing the Escape key.
[/list]
Changes in the EULA: we simply changed the contact email address.

Thank you for all your feedbacks!

Questions Factory

notes.title: Update - Since the playtest
notes.content:
[h3]Many of you have supported us in this adventure![/h3]

Thanks to our testers we were able to make a series of improvements, bug fixes and some new features!

[b]New game elements[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemy class,
[*] New obstacle type,
[*] Addition of a new gadget for the Infiltration Agent,
[*] Addition of two special modes: clock mode and USAC Real,
[*] More lore,
[*] Better overall atmosphere.
[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
We added [b]21 Steam achievements[/b] to feed those who are looking for more challenge! This includes:
[list]
[*] Some achievements related to the storyline,
[*] Achievements based on your performance,
[*] Achievements based on exploration (scanning, collecting objects, exploring hidden areas).
[/list]

[b]Statistics[/b]
We have implemented in-game statistics, they are available once a game is started, it includes the number of failures, deaths, shots fired, neutralized agents etc.

[b]Modes[/b]
Once a game is finished, you will have access to two new game modes:
[list]
[*] Clock mode: the game displays a timer to precisely measure how long it takes you to finish the operation,
[*] USAC Real mode: failure is fatal, the slightest mistake makes you start from the beginning. The save doesn't exist.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
We are working hard to make the experience as smooth as possible. The playtest was an opportunity to test the robustness of the game on a larger scale, and it was very helpful. The fixes include:
[list]
[*] SteamVR no longer launches with the game,
[*] AIs no longer open subway train doors,
[*] Inventory checkpoints overrides no longer leave ghost inventory slots,
[*] Consuming ammo no longer leaves ghost inventory slots,
[*] Auto aim no longer activates behind walls,
[*] Dump door for quatum panels no longer closes when the crane's head is inside the dump area;
[*] Spamming the plugging of the supercapacitor in the hub to reactor corridor no longer lock the main entry,
[*] Correction of typos,
[*] Correction of overlapping text blocks issues on documentation using 1440 game resolution,
[*] Corrections of collision/clipping issues,
[*] During moments of latency, some airlocks could not open,
[*] Centrifuge airlock commands no longer display a moving airlock as "Opened",
[*] Subway trains now detect if the server exit the vehicle while the client is loading a level,
[*] Corrections of elevator blocking entries and detection,
[*] Correction of nav mesh detection during Antikythera's fight,
[*] Corrections of typos,
[*] Added extra blockages to avoid leaving the level
[*] Corrections of mesh errors.
[/list]

Some of you have screens that can negatively affect the overall brightness. We have given the possibility to adjust the Gamma in the menus accordingly.

We can improve the experience at any time with your feedback. So don't hesitate to join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbGfNcetKq]Discord [/url] and discuss!

See you at Genetech!

Azad for Questions Factory
